_note: Blocks an ENTRY if price sits just below the nearest overhead support/resistance zone (pivot-clustered swing highs, min_touches required - same logic and same config/levels.json params as scripts/levels.py). proximity_pct = how close below that zone's near edge counts as 'too close'. Price already ABOVE the zone, or no zone found above price, always passes (fail_mode decides the latter). Per-strategy applicability moved out of this config on 2026-10-25 - see each strategy's own config `exclude_filters` list instead (sr_reversal excludes this filter; see trader/filters/base.py's class docstring for the full mechanism and rationale).
